name: Dominion Energy
description: Dominion Energy is a regulated electric utility holding company serving about 4.1 million primarily electric customers in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina, with about 30.7 GW of generating capacity, 10,800 miles of transmission lines and 80,400 miles of distribution lines. Its two utilities (Virginia Power in Virginia and North Carolina, and Dominion Energy South Carolina) are monopolies in their territories; regulators set rates so the company recovers costs plus a return on invested capital, so earnings grow mainly as capital spending is approved into rates (a $64.7 billion plan for 2026 to 2030, including the Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project). A smaller Contracted Energy segment sells output of the Millstone nuclear plant and contracted renewable plants outside rate regulation. The company sold its East Ohio, PSNC and Questar Gas distribution businesses to Enbridge (the East Ohio, PSNC and Questar Gas Transactions, shown as discontinued operations in the 2023 and 2024 results).

SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

businessLines.name: Dominion Energy Virginia
businessLines.how: Customers pay Virginia Commission and NCUC-approved tariffs monthly; revenue covers fuel (passed through) and operating costs plus a return (ROE 9.80%) on invested capital. Large pieces of capital such as CVOW and solar earn their return through riders (add-on charges) trued up annually.
businessLines.description: Virginia Power: regulated electric generation, transmission and distribution in Virginia (as Dominion Energy Virginia) and North Carolina (Dominion Energy North Carolina); includes the 2.6 GW Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Commercial Project under construction.
